# Helping founders put big ideas into action

##### Passionate, expert support for you and your business

## Our investment team

For us, investment is about more than money. We work with founders to give them the best chance of success, from ideas on a page through to exit. Our team's many years of experience mean they can help our portfolio companies scale at speed, and their expertise spans key fields, from Health to Deep Tech.
